run_train_controlnet: run the ControlNet training script with pretrained Stable Diffusion model and conditioning images
parse_controlnet_args: parse command-line arguments for ControlNet training including dataset paths, batch size, and learning rate
create_train_dataset: create a training dataset from HuggingFace hub or local directory with image, caption, and conditioning image columns
log_validation_images: log validation images generated by the ControlNet pipeline to tensorboard or wandb during training
save_model_card: save a model card README with example images and metadata to the output directory for hub upload
